keep_in_sync: Source of truth: genfleet/sdk tests/fixtures/archives/ (this file, the .tar files and build_fixtures.py). Copied byte-identical into the engine (delivery tests) and the backend (submit-time archive parse).
notes: Every reader refuses an archive whose `valid` is false, for the stated `reason`: link | name | duplicate | type.
Member types are an allow-list: regular file (REGTYPE/AREGTYPE) or directory.
Names: refuse a leading `/`, any `..` segment and a backslash; fold only empty and `.` segments; a name that is only the root (`./`) is skipped if it is a directory and refused otherwise.
Duplicates are counted after folding, directories included.
